counterfactual_missing_items: total occlusion of the right coronary artery (RCA) and subtotal occlusion of the left main coronary artery (LMCA)
decisive_items: Cardiac troponin I level was 25 ng/mL (normal, <0.023 ng/mL)
ST-segment elevation in leads III and aVR, Q wave in lead III, and ST-segment depression in leads I, II, aVL, aVF, and V2 to V6
response.rationale: R2 is directly supported by raw evidence of myocardial necrosis (troponin) and ischemic ECG changes, which are diagnostic of acute myocardial infarction. C1, while anatomically complete, only restates angiographic findings without capturing the acute clinical syndrome. Other candidates are either incomplete (R3, R4) or lack raw support (R5).

rejected.why: Only captures LMCA occlusion, missing the RCA and the acute presentation.
Only captures RCA occlusion, missing the LMCA and the acute presentation.
